definition: Lateral geniculate nucleus: a visual relay in the thalamus. It receives signals from retinal ganglion cells and sends signals through the optic radiation to primary visual cortex.
Primary visual cortex: a cortical area that receives visual input from the LGN and recombines those inputs into signals sent to other visual areas.
The bundle of nerve fibres carrying signals from the LGN to primary visual cortex on the same side of the brain.
